title: First Encounter of Destined Foes: Heavenly Secrets Transformation
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth, complex light flickering in her eyes: 'Your bloodline... could actually suppress my demonic arts?' From this moment, the fates of both were thoroughly intertwined.

text.content:
Morning mist shrouded the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain like a sheer veil. Chen Ji followed the mysterious signal, passing through layers of ancient trees, arriving before a hidden cliff face. At the end of the signal was a blue stone tablet covered in runes, the patterns matching those on the Tianji Record Fragment—a formation entrance he had never seen before.

His heart raced slightly as his fingertips brushed the icy stone surface, sensing the faint spiritual energy fluctuation. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul had mentioned that Chen Xuan had left several secret locations when setting up his chess game, and could this be one of them?

Just then, the mountain wind abruptly stopped, and a fierce killing intent sliced through the silence like a blade. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his body instinctively dodging sideways—a blade of jet-black sword energy slashed through where he had just stood, shattering the blue stone tablet into fragments.

'Sharp perception indeed, worthy of a target for whom the Holy Sect's Saint personally made a move.'

A cold voice drifted from the mist, followed by a graceful figure slowly emerging from the morning fog, surrounded by concentrated demonic energy that seemed to coalesce into physical form, like a dark night elf crawling from an abyss.

It was Ye Qing.

The Saint of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, now gazing down at this 'waste' of Late Foundation Building with the pressure of a Late Gold Core cultivator.

dialogue.content:
'Chen Ji, Tianqing Sect servant disciple, Late Foundation Building cultivation, scarce training resources,平平无奇的Combat Power...' Ye Qing recited from the intelligence scroll in her hand, her tone carrying undisguised contempt. 'The Holy Sect spent three months investigating, all to kill such an ant?'

She put away the scroll, a playful curve forming at the corner of her lips: 'However, dying under this Saint's sword can also be considered your honor.'

Chen Ji slowly turned around, his expressioncalm得近乎cold. He looked at this Demonic Path Saint whose Combat Power far exceeded his own, yet a glimmer of sharp light flickered in the depths of his eyes.

'Did Her Saintliness come all this way just to catch up with a servant disciple?' His voice was steady, betraying not a trace of fear. 'The Demonic Path is in fierce battle with the righteous path, yet Her Saintliness ventures deep into Tianqing Sect territory alone... Too confident, or too dismissive of Tianqing Sect having no one?'

text.content:
Ye Qing hesitated slightly, seemingly not expecting this 'ant' to dare counterattack. She narrowed her eyes, the demonic energy around her churning more violently, the Late Gold Core pressure crushing down like something tangible. The surrounding ancient trees trembled under this pressure, branches and leaves shattering and falling.

'Interesting.' She raised her hand, a jet-black long sword condensing in her palm, bizarre purple-black flames coiling around the blade. 'This Saint wants to see just how long your mouth can stay tough, you waste.'

Before her words even finished, a fierce sword glow had already torn through the air!

choice.prompt: A full-power strike from Late Gold Core is imminent, life and death hanging by a thread! Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: Activate all Bloodline Power and directly clash with Ye Qing, exchanging blow for blow!
choices.visible_cost: Consumes large amounts of Bloodline Power, may expose the existence of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Has a chance to severely wound the Saint, establishing a legendary first battle
choices.risk_hint: After bloodline is exposed, may be targeted by various factions, extremely high risk

text.content:
A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as his hands rapidly formed seals, the sleeping Bloodline Power in his body roaring awake! Golden runes glowed through his skin, forming a dazzling layer of light around him.

'Good!'

Instead of retreating, he charged toward the sword glow, condensing a phantom sword in his left hand to clash head-on with Ye Qing!

choices.description: Only reveal partial strength, using skill to overcome force, seeking opportunities to escape or force a draw
choices.visible_cost: May be suppressed by the Saint, losing all face
choices.visible_reward: Without exposing true strength, future plans remain unaffected
choices.risk_hint: If seen through by the Saint, may miss the opportunity to turn the tide

text.content:
Chen Ji's body surged backward, barely avoiding the sword glow's edge. He deliberately showed an opening, stumbling a few steps, a trace of blood flowing from his mouth.

'Cough... Her Saintliness's cultivation is truly formidable!' He feigned difficulty稳住身形, while his peripheral vision rapidly calculated escape routes.

Seeing this, Ye Qing's contempt deepened: 'Waste is waste, even struggling to block one of this Saint's swords so miserably.'

choices.text: Force a Stalemate and Seek Peace
choices.description: Utilize the Tianji Record ability to predict her attacks, forcing a draw with minimal cost
choices.visible_reward: Forces a stalemate with the Saint without exposing all true strength
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record ability may be察觉by the Saint

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze flickered subtly. At the moment Ye Qing's sword technique was about to strike, a hint of pale golden light appeared in his pupils—the Tianji Record quietly activated.

The future three breaths later presented itself clearly in his mind: Ye Qing's next sword would slash toward his right shoulder.

He sidestepped, avoiding the vital point with minimal movement, while striking back toward Ye Qing's wrist. Using her force, he deflected the sword's momentum. The two separated instantly after contact, ending in an even match.

Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly: 'You... how could you possibly predict this Saint's technique?'

Ye Qing clearly didn't expect this Foundation Buildingtrash to actually block her sword strike. The contempt on her face was gradually replaced by seriousness. She put away her playful mindset, and the demonic energy around her began to rapidly condense, like an awakened ancient fierce beast.

"Impressive skills. No wonder the Holy Sect values you so much." Her voice turned cold. "But... this is where it ends."

Purple-black flames erupted from within her, dyeing the entire area in a sinister dark purple. The starting gesture of the Demonic Path Forbidden Art - Netherworld Heaven-Scorching Art - was forming in her palm.

This was a terrifying power enough to crush Foundation Building and threaten Golden Core!

dialogue.content:
Just as the forbidden art was about to be released, an aged voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind—

"Boy, your bloodline power can suppress her demonic techniques, but now is not the time to reveal everything." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke with gravity. "Use the Heavenly Eye to find the flaws in her demonic art. One strike is enough to turn defeat into victory."

Chen Ji's heart stirred, and the bloodline power沸腾起来 in his body. At the same time, the vertical eye at his brow center slowly opened, pupils flowing with illusions of sun, moon, and stars—Heavenly Eye, activated!

text.content:
In the Heavenly Eye's vision, the demonic energy around Ye Qing churned like a boiling black sea, but beneath that violent表象, Chen Ji clearly saw three extremely hidden flaws—

Three cun below the left collarbone at the meridian intersection; the right rib Qimen acupoint, the node of true qi circulation; and the tiger's mouth of her sword-holding right hand, where a momentary spiritual vacuum appeared due to the forbidden art's backlash.

"Found it!"

Chen Ji's feet stomped, and his entire body shot toward Ye Qing like an arrow leaving the bowstring. His right hand condensed a light sword woven from golden runes, thunder light coiling around the blade—Breaking Formation Thunder!

Just as Ye Qing's Netherworld Heaven-Scorching Art was about to erupt, Chen Ji rushed in from an incredible angle and speed. Her pupils constricted, instinctively wanting to defend, but Breaking Formation Thunder's speed far exceeded her reactions—

"Pui!"

The golden sword light precisely pierced the flaw at her right rib, and the domineering thunder instantly exploded, shattering her demonic energy circulation! At the same time, Chen Ji's left palm slapped her tiger's mouth, sending her sword flying!

Ye Qing grunted, stumbling backward, a trace of blood at the corner of her lips. She stared at this Foundation Buildingtrash in disbelief—

"You... how could you wound this Saint Lady!"

choice.prompt: The Saint Lady is wounded and retreating. This is a great opportunity to press the attack! What should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: While she's sick, kill her! Go all out to completely defeat the Saint Lady!
choices.visible_cost: Reveal all strength, becoming the Demonic Path's sworn enemy unto death
choices.visible_reward: Completely defeat the Saint Lady, becoming famous throughout the world

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze turned cold and sharp. His foot stood firm, and the light sword in his hand condensed thunder might once more, heading directly for Ye Qing's throat要害!

"Saint Lady, you just said it would be an honor for me to die here..." His voice was low and ice-cold. "Now, I return these words to you."

choices.description: Press for a draw while maintaining advantage, preserving room for maneuver, leaving room for future cooperation
choices.visible_cost: Miss the perfect opportunity to kill the Saint Lady
choices.visible_reward: Establish a subtle relationship with the Saint Lady, exploitable later

text.content:
Chen Ji's foot paused, and he withdrew the light sword, but the thunder light still jumped in his palm. He stood with hands behind his back, looking at the狼狈 Saint Lady with a knowing smile.

"Saint Lady, today's battle... how about we end it here?" His tone was calm and indifferent, as if the life-and-death confrontation just now was merely a warm-up. "If we continue, it benefits neither of us."

choices.description: Stop and mock, completely destroy her pride with words
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Saint Lady, triggering more fierce counterattacks
choices.visible_reward: Let the Saint Lady lose face completely, psychologically overwhelmed
choices.risk_hint: If she fights desperately regardless, both may be injured

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't pursue; instead, he stepped back, a playful smile appearing on his face.

"Late Golden Core versus late Foundation Building, and it comes to this... Saint Lady, are you sure you came here to kill me, not to送 me experience?" His words were like a soft knife, precisely stabbing into Ye Qing's proud heart.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's face turned ashen, her chest heaving. She was a once-in-ten-thousand-years genius of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, breaking through to Golden Core at twenty, never having met an equal among her peers. Today, she had been publicly wounded by a Foundation Buildingtrash and mocked like this—

"You're seeking death!"

She laughed in fury, her hands forming seals at lightning speed, and the demonic energy around her began to madly gather. An even more terrifying aura was brewing within her—the forcibly suppressed backlash of the forbidden art—Demonic Devouring Heaven!

"This move, this Saint Lady originally planned to keep for dealing with the Tianqing Sect elders..." Madness flashed in her eyes. "Since you seek death, then use your blood as the banner's offering!"

text.content:
The heavens and earth changed color in an instant.

Pitch-black demonic energy swept forward like an apocalyptic flood, carrying power enough to destroy everything. Ye Qing herself transformed into a goddess of the dark night, and behind her, countless screaming ghosts surged forth, completely surrounding Chen Ji.

This was a terrifying strike that could threaten Nascent Soul stage!

However, facing this world-destroying offensive, Chen Ji showed not a trace of fear. Instead, a faint smile curved his lips, as if he had long seen through everything.

dialogue.content:
"Holy Maiden, your move... has a flaw."

Chen Ji's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached Ye Qing's ears. He slowly raised his right hand, and an ancient Heavenly Secrets rune appeared in his palm.

"Your Demon Devours the Heavens requires your essence blood as a catalyst, forcibly driving your meridians to output ten times the normal amount..." His tone was calm as still water, as if stating an insignificant fact, "But your right flank has already been wounded by me. True Qi circulation is blocked."

Before his words even finished, he stepped forward violently. Golden runes exploded around him, forming a brilliant curtain of light.

"Therefore—this move, you cannot execute."

text.content:
Golden light collided violently with pitch-black demonic energy!

Chen Ji was forced back several steps by the tremendous recoil, spitting a mouthful of blood. But his gaze remained firmly locked on Ye Qing—her face had suddenly turned deathly pale. The forbidden technique of Demon Devours the Heavens had gone out of control at the final moment, rebounding on its user!

"Pfft!"

Ye Qing was counteracted by her own forbidden technique, blood gushing from her mouth. Her body stumbled and she knelt on one knee. Her eyes were filled with disbelief—how could this waste see through the flaw in her demonic art?

Everyone present was stunned.

A Foundation Building waste actually wounded the Golden Core late-stage Demon Path Holy Maiden twice!

choice.prompt: The Holy Maiden was counteracted by the forbidden technique, her combat power plummeting—this is the perfect moment to subdue her!

choices.description: Display the bearing of a king, attempt to take Ye Qing as your own

text.content:
Chen Ji stepped forward, but he didn't continue attacking. He looked down at Ye Qing kneeling on the ground, his tone carrying a hint of playfulness.

"Holy Maiden, there was originally no deep grudge between us. What do the conflicts between the Demon Path and the righteous path have to do with two young people?" He extended his hand, "So... shall we make a deal?"

choices.text: Releasing the Tiger Back to the Mountain
choices.description: Know when to stop, leave handsomely, leaving behind a legend
choices.visible_cost: Lose the excellent opportunity to subdue the Holy Maiden
choices.visible_reward: Make the Holy Maiden owe a tremendous favor
choices.risk_hint: May be retaliated against by the Holy Maiden in the future

text.content:
Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze calmly sweeping over the disheveled Ye Qing.

"Today's battle, consider it a draw between us." He turned his back to the Holy Maiden, his voice cold and clear, "Holy Maiden, next time you want to kill someone, remember to first inquire about your opponent's background."

He lifted his foot to leave. His silhouette stretched a long shadow in the morning light. Behind him, Ye Qing stared at his back intently, her eyes flickering with complex brilliance.

choices.description: While she's weakened, thoroughly eliminate future troubles
choices.visible_cost: Offending the Demon Path Holy Sect may bring endless retaliation
choices.visible_reward: Permanently eliminate hidden dangers, gain treasures from the Holy Maiden
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Maiden may have life-saving trump cards not yet revealed

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze turned cold. The light sword in his hand gathered thunder light once more. He walked step by step toward the weakened Ye Qing, the sword tip pointing directly at her brow center.

"Holy Maiden, you just said it would be an honor for me to die here..." A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth, "Now, I'll return those words to you."

dialogue.content:
Just as Chen Ji was about to make his final decision at this crucial moment, Ye Qing suddenly spoke.

"Wait!"

Her voice was hoarse, yet carried a resolute meaning. She raised her head, their eyes meeting. Complex brilliance flickered in her gaze.

"This Holy Maiden... admits defeat." She spoke with difficulty, each word seeming to be squeezed out from between her teeth, "But before I die, can you tell me—who exactly are you? Why can you see through the flaws in my demonic art?"

Chen Ji stopped walking, looking down at this proud Holy Maiden from above.

Her pride had been thoroughly shattered at this moment. The pressure of Golden Core late-stage was completely gone, leaving only a狼狈求生的女子. But even so, defiance and stubbornness remained in her eyes—this slightly surprised Chen Ji.

"You want to know?" He squatted down, at eye level with Ye Qing, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his mouth, "That depends on what price you're willing to pay."

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly retracted the light sword, standing up. He looked at Ye Qing kneeling on the ground, his eyes holding no killing intent, only unfathomable calm.

"Holy Maiden, if I wanted to kill you, I would have done so earlier." His voice was plain, yet carried an unquestionable authority, "But killing you... brings me no benefit."

He turned around. Morning wind whistled past, making his robes flutter violently.

"Today's matter, consider it a misunderstanding. You go your way, I cross my bridge." He paused, his tone gaining deeper meaning, "Of course, if you're willing... perhaps we can find another way to interact."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing was stunned.

She had thought she was doomed, never expecting this decisive "waste" to let her go. This defied all logic—people of the Demon Path always root out every trace of trouble, leaving no future dangers.

"You... just let me go like that?" She couldn't help but ask, her voice carrying uncertainty.

Chen Ji didn't look back. He merely left behind a sentence: "Holy Maiden, what do you think... since you owe me your life, how do you plan to repay it later?"

Ye Qing's pupils contracted violently. A great storm churned in her heart. This waste... from the very beginning, had no intention of killing her, but of calculating her life!

text.content:
Watching Chen Ji's departing figure, Ye Qing was unable to回过神来良久.

Her pride, her confidence, all her dignity as a Demon Path Saintess had been thoroughly shattered in today's confrontation. And what frightened her most was—she had no idea how much strength this wastrel had concealed.

"Chen Ji..." she murmured this name, carving it into the deepest recesses of her heart, "I will definitely uncover your secrets."

Struggling to stand, she stumbled and vanished into the morning mist. But what she didn't notice was that after she left, Chen Ji emerged from behind the tree, a meaningful smile curving his lips.

dialogue.content:
"Mo Xiansheng, it seems this Saintess... is far more interesting than I anticipated." Chen Ji said in his heart.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a low laugh: "Boy, your performance today exceeded this old man's expectations. However—" His tone grew solemn, "Your bloodline power has been exposed. If someone with ill intentions were to notice..."

"I know." Chen Ji nodded, his gaze drifting toward the distance, "That's why I let her live. A Demon Path Saintess's life... is worth far more than a Servant Disciple's."

A flash of sharpness crossed his eyes: Today's draw was merely the beginning.

text.content:
As morning light intensified, the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain returned to stillness.

Chen Ji stood before the shattered Blue Stone Platform, crouching to carefully examine the remaining runes. Though the cipher had been destroyed, he had already memorized its pattern—this was a key to somewhere.

"The things Master Chen Xuan left behind are indeed extraordinary." He murmured, firmly committing the rune patterns to his heart.

This battle, where he—a Foundation Building cultivator—had forced a draw with a Golden Core expert, marked the first step in his rise to fame. But more importantly—he had planted a piece on the board that could stir the winds and clouds.

Demon Path Saintess Ye Qing owed him a life. This debt would someday be repaid.

Chen Ji straightened his clothes and walked out of the Back Mountain as if nothing had happened, as if that thrilling life-and-death confrontation had never occurred.

However, on his way back to the Servants' Quarters, a cold figure blocked his path—a clear and icy presence standing right where he had to pass. It was Su Qingyao, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect.

She crossed her arms, her gaze like a blade examining this "waste" of a Servant Disciple, her brow subtly revealing a hint of confusion and probing.

"Chen Ji, you smell of blood." Her voice was cold, "Tell me, where were you just now?"

Chen Ji's heart tensed, but an innocuous smile spread across his face: "Senior Su, the disciple only went to the Back Mountain to gather firewood, and accidentally scraped some skin..."
